summary: Windows WPF app for managing local winget package workflows.
active_objective: Completed code fix for Anthropic.Claude update attempts where winget exits successfully but the installer log reports MSIX package-in-use error 0x80073D02.
assumptions: The user is reporting a runtime update workflow result from OnlyWinget rather than asking only for manual log inspection.
decisions: OnlyWinget now reads targeted diagnostics from the winget operation log and maps MSIX package-in-use error 0x80073D02 to the existing App in use status instead of leaving only the generic still-available result.
next_tasks: Close running Claude processes and rerun the Claude update on the local machine when it is safe to interrupt the app.
blockers: Local Claude 1.5354.0.0 processes are still running and must be closed before the MSIX registration can complete.
risks: Stopping Claude automatically could interrupt active user work, so the running processes were not terminated.
last_completed_work: Mapped winget MSIX package-in-use installer log diagnostics to App in use and added regression coverage.
open_questions: Should the local Claude processes be closed now so the update can be retried?
handoff_notes: Observed winget still reports Anthropic.Claude 1.5354.0.0 -> 1.6608.1. The latest diagnostic log reports 0x80073D02 and lists Claude_1.5354.0.0_x64__pzs8sxrjxfjjc as needing to be closed.
